verdict: Meta ads went dark six days ago, stopping all new leads.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 66 leads entirely through Meta at a cost of $8.63 per lead — a solid baseline. However, Meta has been at zero spend and zero leads since September 15, cutting off your only paid lead source for six consecutive days. Separately, 63 new opportunities were recorded in your pipeline this period, but none converted to booked appointments or closed value, which points to a intake or follow-up gap independent of ad delivery. We are working to restore Meta delivery immediately and are addressing the pipeline flow in parallel. You should expect lead volume to resume as soon as Meta is back live, and we will have a clearer picture of the pipeline issue within the coming week.
